newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Singapore rubber futures closed lower across the board on Monday on late selling interest in line with softer Japanese prices, brokers said.
Prices in Tokyo and Kobe were marked down slightly on sporadic selling and bearish sentiment carried over from last week.

"The market was quiet in the morning except for a solitary deal for RSS3 rubber in the ring session. But prices turned softer in the afternoon in sympathy with weaker prices in Tokyo and Kobe," a local broker said.
"The major consumers are not in the market so far, but I wouldn't be surprised if they're checking prices to see if an opportunity will present itself," a dealer said.
At 0945 GMT, July RSS3 fell 2.50 cents to 110.00 U.S. cent a kg. January/March RSS1 eased 0.75 cent to 165.00 Singapore cents (US$1.16) a kg.
July TSR20 was indicated at S$147.50 Singapore cents (US$1.04) a kg compared with last Friday's settlemnt of 149.50 cents.
